title: Real incidents of agents causing damage + state of automated failure attribution
outcome: A sourced incident catalogue and attribution evidence that make the problem concrete for the framing and give us realistic test scenarios
acceptance: ≥6 real incidents with primary/first-hand URLs (e.g. Replit DB deletion Jul 2025, AI Incident Database entries), each with: what broke, who detected, time-to-detect/contain/recover if known, how recovered
Summary of Who&When (arXiv 2505.00212) and ≥1 follow-up: exact reported attribution accuracies with dataset/setting
Pattern analysis: which incidents a per-agent selective rollback would have fixed vs. not
'Implications for framing' and 'Implications for our design' sections (incl. 3 candidate demo scenarios)
